meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用测试驱动的方式构建功能或修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯先写测试再写代码，或需要提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Build features or fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer writing tests before code or need to improve code quality

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照红-绿-重构循环指导你编写测试：先写失败测试，再写刚好能通过的代码，不提前写多余测试或功能。
howto.when: 当你说“测试驱动开发”、“红绿重构”或要求先写测试再写功能时触发。

say.text: 用 TDD 写一个用户登录功能
say.note: Claude 会引导你从写失败测试开始。

say.text: 帮我修复这个 bug，先写测试
say.note: Claude 会先写一个暴露 bug 的测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through the red-green-refactor cycle: write a failing test first, then just enough code to pass it, without anticipating future tests or features.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "test-driven development", "red-green-refactor", or ask to write tests before implementing features or fixing bugs.

say_en.text: Use TDD to write a user login feature
say_en.note: Claude will start by writing a failing test.

say_en.text: Fix this bug with tests first
say_en.note: Claude will write a test that exposes the bug first.
